description.en: Indicates whether this is a shared link. If it is, the \`token\` parameter is also required.

descriptions.zh: 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解PAI-DLC产品的收费方式和[价格](~~171758~~)。
descriptions.en: Before using this API, review the billing methods and [pricing](~~171758~~) for PAI-DLC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pai-dlc get-dashboard --job-id dlc1k7426goc7bvy --is-shared false --token some_token_value --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun pai-dlc GET /api/v1/jobs/dlc1k7426goc7bvy/dashboard --region cn-hangzhou --isShared false --token some_token_value --header "Content-Type=application/json"
